prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical locker-room portrait of an approved adult woman making a quiet gesture beside a tiled stall wall.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with dirty-blonde/light-brown hair in a high ponytail, cream fabric headband, fair warm skin, dramatic winged eyeliner, small gold hoops, and a white wireless earbud. She turns her back and head toward camera, holds one index finger vertically to her lips, and places the other palm on the wall. She wears a sage-green ribbed sports bra and dark forest-green high-waisted athletic shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 eye-level portrait from behind, subject framed between a dark stall partition and beige tiled wall with brown accent stripe. Preserve the partial sign at left and silver stall hardware as environmental details.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Overhead fluorescent indoor light with soft highlights and shadows, clean realistic tile and fabric texture, composed fitness-editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high detail, 9:16 vertical framing, eye-level perspective, sharp face and hands, natural skin texture, realistic hair flyaways and tile reflections.
